summary: Replication exchanges send deltas only: a compact answer lists the differing ranges that hold live envelopes first, from a different range on each answer, and the worker no longer falls back to a full-inventory round that sent each side's whole inventory (about 228 MB on a million-envelope store) whenever ranges differed only by checkpoint identities

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: This build never sends a request without range digests, so it no longer asks a peer for its complete inventory. It still answers an older peer's full-inventory request with its complete inventory, so members may upgrade in any order; the large answers stop once every member runs this build.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
